image_description: Four baby bibs arranged in a two-by-two grid on a flat surface. The top-left bib is white with lace trim and embroidered sheep; the top-right is cream-colored with lace trim and an embroidered girl; the bottom-left is cream with a green turtle embroidery; the bottom-right is cream with a pink snail embroidery. All feature scalloped lace edges and visible neck openings.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific classification of the objects as bibs and distinguish from similar garments like aprons or smocks.
AI often struggles with complex, repetitive boundaries like lace. This expert will verify if the lace is structurally connected to the bib body or if it floats/fuses incorrectly.
To check for coherence in the embroidered designs (turtle, snail, etc.) and ensure they don't exhibit melting or nonsensical thread structures.
To ensure the overlapping arrangement of the four bibs has correct depth ordering and no spatial bleeding between layers.

focus_areas: Integrity of lace trim connections to the main fabric body
Coherence and logical structure of embroidered motifs
Correct depth ordering where bibs overlap
Texture consistency of the fabric weave
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the lace edges. In AI images, lace often becomes a blurry mess or fuses into the background. Verify if the holes in the lace are distinct and if the lace sits naturally on the fabric plane. Also, inspect the embroidery for 'thread melting' where colors bleed into each other unnaturally.
